items.text: No one wants to be a Bootlegged Maze Runner.

When I was maybe ten-ish, I was sleeping over with one of my mom's friends. The bedroom one of my sister's an I slept in had a bunk bed with the top bunk having no railing.
'F course me loving the top bunk I claimed it like a sucker.

Until that night I didn't even know I rolled in my sleep. I woke up while falling, and I landed on the (luckily) carpeted floor with my forearms tucked under me.
That is making my scalp itch, wtf

When I was six years old, I was at a grocery store with some of my friends, one of them dared me to eat a cherry tomato. I refused at first, because I didn't want to steal (I was a goody-two-shoes) but when they turned their backs, my pride got the better of me and I snuck one into my mouth anyway.

No one ever questioned me about it, but I felt bad about doing it still.
Oh gosh that sounds terrifying and sad. You must have had a lot of courage to continue on after that.

items.title: They shouldn't have been there.
items.text:
They shouldn't have been there.
This is pretty short as it was only a brief moment, but I thought it was ridiculous enough to share here. The event happened on Monday of this week. (April 22nd)

It was a rainy day, and me an one of my casual friends were waiting at the bus station for our bus. The station has this rule where only buses and station security are allowed to drive through it, and there are even big red signs for it.

Though my friend pointed out that there was a grey Ford driving into the station, and just as she said that the bus drivers the car passed by started leaning on their horns. The Ford drove by and who was sitting at the driver's seat but a meth-faced bleach-haired Karen with a kid in the back. She was honked at again as she drove by another bus when she left.

I was honestly confused, but amused. I couldn't believe I saw an entitled parent with my own two eyes. The legends are true, and I'm happy that my encounter didn't go any farther than that. Thank you for reading.

Some of these would also apply to Russian.

Source: I am fluent in Russian.
